changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6625-retire-fieldmeta-decimals.md`

- names `fields/src/index.tsx` → `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `buildFieldMeta` computed `decimals: overrides.decimals ?? meta?.decimals ?? meta?.scale` on **every** call and the value **reached nothing**. Re-measured on this branch's base (`efdc6c62`): **zero `.decimals` member reads** across `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/core` and `plugin-dashboard` itself — the only non-comment occurrence was the write being removed here. The **positive control in the same query shape** fires: `.scale` member reads hit `NumberField.tsx`, `GridField.tsx` and `fields/src/index.tsx`. So the zero is a finding, not a broken query. The `overrides.decimals ??` head of that chain had already lost its only feeder when objectui#6425's ruling removed the authored read from `ObjectDataTable.enrich()`; `RecordDetailDrawer`, the only other `buildFieldMeta` caller, passes no overrides at all. Both halves retire together, so the key leaves in one move.

### `.changeset/6694-dashboard-lookup-reference-meta.md`

- names `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` → `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` — edited by this change

  > ⚠️ The copy set is three keys where `ObjectGrid`'s `RELATIONAL_META_KEYS` is nine, and the difference is measured per key, not preferred. The grid's cells are EDITABLE, so its extra keys drive the inline picker's query (`LookupField` / `UserField` read `id_field`, `description_field`, `lookup_filters`, `lookupFilters`); these two widgets are read-only and their render path ends at a cell renderer. `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` reads exactly `reference_to`, `reference` and `display_field` off a cell's `field` prop; `titleFormat` is never read off a field meta at all (its readers take it off the object schema, which arrives here through `useRefObjectSchema(reference_to)`), and `reference_to_field` has zero member reads anywhere in the repo. Copying the other six would mint six members written on every call and read by nothing — precisely what objectui#6625 (`decimals`) and objectui#6597 (`referenceTo`) retired from this same file.

### `.changeset/6837-reference-to-arm-deletion.md`

- names `fields/src/index.tsx` → `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Three readers were deliberately left alone.** `LookupCellRenderer` (`fields/src/index.tsx`), `LookupField` and `UserField` read `FieldMetadata` — ObjectUI's OWN contract, whose `LookupFieldMetadata` declares `reference_to` and never declares `reference`. They are fed by the emitters above and by published example schemas (`examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/fields-lookup/*.json`), so narrowing them would break in-repo producers, and `plugin-grid`'s `relationalMetaCopySet.derivation.test.ts` re-derives its read set from exactly those three sources — where `reference_to` is recorded with verdict `adapter-stamped`. `DetailViewFieldSchema` is likewise untouched.

### `.changeset/7166-retire-inert-fieldmeta-copies.md`

- names `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` → `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `applyRelationalMeta` writes the copy set onto the `fieldMeta` that `generateColumns` hands to `ANGLE-BRACKETS(CellRenderer)` as the `field` prop — six JSX passes across the three column-building paths, and nowhere else. For a relational column that resolves to `LookupCellRenderer`, which reads exactly `reference_to`, `reference`, `display_field`, `displayField`, `reference_field` and `options`; a `user` column resolves to `UserCellRenderer`, which destructures `{ value }` and reads no field meta at all. Measured by receiver rather than by count: `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, the file holding **every** cell renderer, contains **zero** occurrences of the three retired keys, against a control of 22 occurrences of the `display_field` / `displayField` / `reference_to` spellings the cell does read.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `6ea68e63e` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1456 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2038 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36121383501)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e604834d4f24a7adcfcb62b2ffcdbeb232d3238c`

Reviewed against: card objectui#10493 (body, triage 5828367857, claim 5829645437), PR objectui#10575 body and file list, the diff from merge-base `8740e86cedefb8b568011fbc3d158e0d3f504983` (main at review time `a506001`), read via `refs/review/pr-10575` and `refs/review/main`. Five files, +247/-7. Branch commits: 6db588b fix, 4e59a60 test typing, 35e3260 merge of origin/main 8740e86, e604834 doc. The `os-dev-report` comment's claims were not used as evidence.

### ① Derived judgments

**Behaviour, accepted-set and published-surface changes, each judged against the card**

1. `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts:121-122` — `nameFromUrl` now returns `undefined` when the URL matches `/^data:/i`; return type widened to `string | undefined`. The triage execution note binds: 「`nameFromUrl` yields no name for a `data:` URI, so the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` applies; ⛔ no change to stored values.」 RIGHT. The case-insensitive scheme match was not asked; it is one token, correct for URL schemes, and pinned (`file-value.test.ts:138`).

2. `file-value.ts:144` — the string arm reads `name: nameFromUrl(value) ?? fallbackName`; `url: value` is still the raw string. The object arm (`file-value.ts:154-158`) was already `?? fallbackName` and is unchanged. RIGHT, and the stored-value constraint holds: nothing the function returns as `url` or `raw` changes.

3. `file-value.ts:38-43` — the `FileValueView.name` doc drops "Never empty". The type `name: string` is unchanged. Not asked, but the claim's surface names this file, and change 4 makes the old sentence false (an empty fallback is now passed), so leaving it would have shipped a false doc. Accepted.

4. `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:2205-2208` — `displayableImagesOf` passes `''` as the fallback and maps `name: v.name || undefined`; its return type gains `name?: string`. Consumers: `ImageCellRenderer` (`index.tsx:2228`, alt through `imageAlt` at `2236-2237`: `name || t('fields.image.imageAlt', …)`), `SignatureCellRenderer` (`index.tsx:2328`, length only), and `ImageLightbox` (`ImageLightbox.tsx:16` already `name?: string`; alt `:77` and dialog title `:73` fall through to `t(...)`). The claim allowed `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` 「only if its alt wiring must change for the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` to apply」. At the merge-base the helper passed the literal `'Image'`, so with change 2 alone a data-URI image would be named `Image` and `name ||` would never reach `t(...)`; the translated alt cannot apply without this edit, and it is the smallest one (the alt expressions themselves are untouched). RIGHT, within the claimed surface.

5. Consequences of 4 that the card did not ask for: (a) a bare `sys_file` id, and an id-only or url-only object, in an `image` / `avatar` / `signature` cell now read the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` instead of the untranslated literal `Image`. No ruling forbids this; it is the same fallback the card asks to reach; pinned (`cellRenderers.dataUriAlt-10493.test.tsx:129-136`); and no existing test pinned `alt="Image"` (grep at the merge-base over `*.test.*`, `__tests__/**`, `*.snap`: 0 hits). Accepted. (b) Through change 2, every other `readFileValue` caller's data-URI name moves: `FileCellRenderer` (`index.tsx:2143`, `2185`) and `FileField.tsx:169`, `:487` pass the translated `fields.file.fileFallback`, so a `data:` value's link text and `title` in a file cell or file widget move from the base64 tail to that translation (`file-affordance.tsx:84`, `:91`, `:100`). `ImageField.tsx:84` passes the literal `'Image'`, so its alt moves from base64 to `Image`. `ObjectGallery.tsx:238` reads `.url` only, unchanged. None of these is against a ruling; (b) is the same a11y defect class and is disclosed (changeset lines 21-23 for the file cell; the PR body for the rest); `ImageField.tsx` is outside the claimed surface and is correctly left alone and reported. Accepted.

**Asked and missing**: nothing. Ask 1 (no name for a `data:` URI): done. Ask 2 (the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` applies): done for all three cells — the renderer map (`index.tsx:3374-3378`) routes `image` and `avatar` to `ImageCellRenderer` and `signature` to `SignatureCellRenderer`, which draws through the same helper. Constraint 「⛔ no change to stored values」: held (change 2; every cell pin asserts the `src` is the value byte for byte, test lines 108, 115, 133, 140). The claim's pin ask (「the three cells' alt is the translated string for a `data:` value. Lit control: an `https://…/photo.png` value still names the image `photo.png`」): both present, test lines 97-125. The one `.changeset/10493-…md`: present.

**Done that was not asked**: the case-insensitive scheme (1), the doc correction (3), and the consequences in 5 — each judged above; none weakens a guard or crosses the claimed surface. AGENTS.md #11 (no `path:line` citations): 0 in the added lines.

**Existing pins edited or deleted**: none. `file-value.test.ts` is +37/-0; no other test file is touched. The merge-base 8677 census (`cellRenderers.signatureValueClass-8677.test.tsx:251-267`) compares the signature cell's markup to the image cell's for the data-URI string; both render through `displayableImagesOf`, so the two move together and the pin keeps holding (CI's test shards are the measurement).

**Can the new pins fail?**
- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.dataUriAlt-10493.test.tsx` (new). Lit control at `:121-125`: an `https://cdn.example.com/a/photo.png` value on each of the three cells must read `photo.png`, so a caricature that always answers the translated alt fails it. Negative leg: at the merge-base `nameFromUrl` yields `png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo=` for the reproduction value, so `:104` (`not.toContain('base64')`) and `:105` (`toBe(packAlt(...))`) fail without the fix; with only the `file-value.ts` half the alt is the literal `Image`, which fails `:105` in both locales (`Image` differs from `Image 1` and from `图片 1`). The premise pin `:86-92` requires the zh and en pack values to differ (`en.ts:265` `Image {{index}}`, `zh.ts:237` `图片 {{index}}`), so no single literal can pass both locale legs. The pins reach the renderers the way consumers do (`getCellRenderer(resolveCellRendererType(...))`, `index.tsx:3023`, `:3435`), leaving `SignatureCellRenderer` unexported as objectui#8677 ruled. `@object-ui/i18n/locales` is a published subpath (`packages/i18n/package.json` exports `./locales`) already imported by five sibling fields tests; the `I18nProvider` config shape is used by three siblings; the file name follows the seven `cellRenderers.TOPIC-CARD.test.tsx` siblings.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.test.ts:117-146` (five rows). Negative leg: at the merge-base `readFileValue(DATA_URI).name` is the base64 tail, not `File`, so `:121-122` fail; `:137` fails (base names it `cd+ef==`); `:138` fails. Lit control `:141-145`: `https` as a string and as `{ url }`, and `blob:`, must keep their last segment.

### ② Semver level

- The diff changes published executable source under `packages/fields/src/` of `@object-ui/fields`, a member of the `fixed` group in `.changeset/config.json`, so AGENTS.md (line 168) owes a changeset with a bump. Present: `.changeset/10493-data-uri-no-file-name.md:2` `'@object-ui/fields': patch`. Not a docs-only change, so the empty-frontmatter rule does not apply.
- Level: no export added or removed (the barrel's `export * from './widgets/file-value.js'` at `index.tsx:4304` re-exports the same symbols; `displayableImagesOf`, `nameFromUrl` and `SignatureCellRenderer` stay unexported), no signature or type moves (`FileValueView.name: string`), no accepted input moves. A display-name fix; not breaking, so `patch` is right under 版本号策略 (no `major` declared; `minor` is reserved for breaking changes).
- Changeset prose, sentence by sentence (`.changeset/10493-data-uri-no-file-name.md`):
  - L5 title — TRUE (pinned).
